fields.description: Site name on Pilot, e.g. suite-3f9a1c2b.blr1.frappe.cloud.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Domain the site is served under, e.g. acme.sites.example.com. Blank until a domain is attached.
fields.label: Primary Domain

fields.description: Pending: waits for a server with room. Creating: Pilot creates it. Ready: in the pool, not claimed. Assigned, Configuring: being connected to its tenant. Active: in use. Failed: stopped on an error, run Retry. Dropping: being deleted. Dropped: deleted from its server.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Empty while the site waits in the pool.
fields.label: Tenant

fields.description: Short name of the tenant, e.g. acme. Gives the site domain and the mail domain.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Why the site failed or what it waits for.
fields.label: Error

fields.description: Pilot created the site with the Suite app.
fields.label: Site Created

fields.description: Pilot task that creates or drops the site, while it runs.
fields.label: Pilot Task

fields.description: The site has its Suite Cloud URL, tenant ID and secret. Clear it to configure the site again.
fields.label: Suite Configured

fields.description: Mail Account Request that invites the tenant owner. The owner sets a password when they accept it.
fields.label: Owner Invite

fields.description: The invite is valid for 7 days.
fields.label: Owner Invited At

fields.description: Make the label under the site DNS zone the primary domain, e.g. acme.sites.example.com. Fixed after the domain is added.
